records.title: Daily emollient during infancy for prevention of eczema: the BEEP randomised controlled trial
funding_notes: UK NIHR Health Technology Assessment programme.
financial_interest_notes: Several outside-work industry relationships, institutional Nestlé partnership, and funding-programme affiliations disclosed; investigators affiliated with programme were not involved in its award decision.

fresh_selected_check.finding: High-risk term infants: eczema by age two 139/598 versus 150/612; adjusted RR 0.95 (95% CI 0.78–1.16). No clear preventive benefit; skin infection signal reported.
fresh_selected_check.limitations: High-risk population, specified products and outcome definitions; separate prevention from eczema treatment.
fresh_selected_check.funding: UK NIHR Health Technology Assessment programme.

funding_notes: NIH NIAMS AR071057 and NIH data-platform support.
financial_interest_notes: L'Oreal, Galderma and Pharmaceutical Specialties supplied products; authors report companies not involved in trial design, implementation, analysis or reporting; outside-work industry ties disclosed.

fresh_selected_check.locator: Abstract, results, funding/support and role of sponsor
fresh_selected_check.finding: US pragmatic RCT, 1,247 dyads not selected for high risk: eczema incidence 36.1% vs 43.0% at 24 months, RR 0.84 (95% CI 0.73–0.97).
fresh_selected_check.limitations: Different risk selection from BEEP, missing-outcome imputation and formulation switching; no basis for brand ranking or universal prevention regimen.
